verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a Data Source verification check that confirms identity information (name, DOB, ID numbers, addresses) against regulated data sources, separate from Documentary Verification. Workflows can run checks conditionally, for example triggering a document scan only when another verification fails, which supports lower-friction doc-free flows. Missing for 10: explicit naming of SSN, national-registry, or credit-header sources; per-country data source coverage; independent or hands-on corroboration.
